articles.summary: If you pay attention to financial media, you’re likely to hear quite a bit about September being the worst month for investors. While this is indeed borne out by the data – September is indeed the month with the lowest mean return for key indexes – seasonality is a fickle guide. Long-term averages are one thing; performance in any given month is another.
articles.title: Should We Trust Seasonality?
